Hosmer–Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test

Source: R/hosmer_lemeshow.r
ks_hosmer_lemeshow.Rd

Groups fitted probabilities into quantile-based bins, cross-tabulates observed versus expected successes/failures, and returns the chi-squared statistic with `g - 2` degrees of freedom (Hosmer & Lemeshow, 1980). A high p-value indicates no evidence of miscalibration.

Usage

ks_hosmer_lemeshow(y, yhat, g = 10)

Arguments

y

Binary response (0/1), same length as `yhat`.

yhat

Fitted probabilities from a logistic model.

g

Number of groups (default 10 = deciles).

Value

A list with components chisq and p.value.

References

Hosmer, D. and Lemeshow, S. (1980). Goodness of fit tests for the multiple logistic regression model. Biometrics, 36, 1045–1054.

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(200))
d$y <- rbinom(200, 1, plogis(0.8 * d$x))
m <- glm(y ~ x, binomial, data = d)
ks_hosmer_lemeshow(d$y, fitted(m))
#> $chisq
#> [1] 5.995023
#> 
#> $p.value
#> [1] 0.6477895
#> 
#> $df
#> [1] 8
#>
